lines.text:
Come on, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!
You do know you can do more with Pokémon
than just catch ’em, right?\c
If you’re a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Trainer[VAR COLOR(0000)], you can have [VAR COLOR(0006)]Pokémon battles[VAR COLOR(0000)]
with other Trainers, too!\c
I’ll show you exactly what I mean!

[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Aw, jeez...
There I went mouthing off like I knew everything,
and then I lost! How embarrassing!\c
I probably should’ve trained my Pokémon up
a bit before trying a battle like that, huh?
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Yes! I did it!\c\n...Oh!\nBut don’t worry about one little loss, OK?
OAK: Did you enjoy your first taste of battle,\nyoung [VAR TRNAME(0000)]?\c\nYour partner [VAR POKNAME(0002)] seemed to like it!

OAK: Battle against many Trainers, and help your
Pokémon grow strong!\c
And keep catching more and more new Pokémon
while you’re at it, too!
